reviews.text: Truly an excellent experience! Domenico treated my little Maltipoo with extraordinary care, kindness, and attention. You can immediately sense his great expertise, professionalism, and above all, the love he puts into his work. The result was impeccable. Highly recommended!

I called Domenico in a panic because I'd found a small animal on my dog, Sole. He was incredibly helpful, giving me an appointment right away and handling the situation professionally. I had a really great experience. Highly recommended.

We went to Domenico's today for the first time with our 6-year-old golden retriever Maya.
The experience was truly positive, and Domenico does his job with great professionalism and passion.
We'll definitely see you again!
Thank you for making our "blonde" even more charming 😝

Domenico was incredibly welcoming and, from the very first moment, explained to us with great kindness how to best care for our dog's fur.
He cared for our little dog with great care and professionalism, taking care of every detail. The end result is truly exceptional: the coat is perfect, and you can see all the passion he puts into his work.
We are truly satisfied with the experience and will definitely be back. Highly recommended for anyone looking for expertise, kindness, and top-notch service!
Kind, competent, honest and helpful person, who loves his job but above all loves dogs 🐶💪🏻🥰 highly recommended ‼️
I took my dog ​​to Boutique del Pelo for a wash and cut. The staff were friendly, and the dog came back nice and clean. It was a great place, and I had a great time. I'll be back. Thank you so much.

Met at a fair, a monthly regular, Domenico is the best. Love, professionalism, and courtesy—it couldn't be better!
First of all, given the superficiality of so many who approach this job, I've never taken my Cocker Spaniel anywhere else. Well, with Domenico, I'd even give her a foster home. Top Top.
Very good, helpful and kind and excellent human heart, I will always return, excellent qualities

I took my Cocker Spaniel to him and couldn't be more satisfied.
Beyond the impeccable grooming, what makes the difference is the way he does it: attention to detail, knowledgeable, and with a rare affection. My dog ​​was calm and pampered.
You can see the passion and politeness in his relationship with both the animal and the owner.
If you're looking for a trustworthy groomer, this is THE PLACE!!!!

Boutique del Pelo is a guarantee. I've been taking my Scar there to get a bath since he was a puppy, almost three years now. Besides being a great professional, the owner, Domenico, has also become a great friend. Every time we walk by the shop, Scar always wants to go inside; he's not at all afraid to come in. This is because of the complete trust that has developed between Domenico and the dog...that's absolutely not a given. Always available, kind, and attentive to every dog's needs.
I absolutely recommend Mimmo's grooming.
Qualified and professional staff. My dog ​​finally smells clean. Congratulations!

Excellent experience! Domenico took care of my dog ​​Dea with great professionalism, attention, and kindness. He bathed and cut her impeccably, respecting her needs and making her feel calm the entire time. The result was truly fantastic: Dea came out clean, smelling good, and beautiful! You can tell Domenico loves his job and animals. I highly recommend his service to anyone looking for a competent, reliable, and passionate groomer. Thanks again from me and Dea! ❤️🐾
The best for professionalism and humanity, I couldn't have made a better choice, my puppy is perfect 🫶 …

From Pagani to Naples, only for the professionalism and care. With Mimmo, my Pomeranian, he was exceptional: after the treatment, he was reborn. You can tell when someone works with passion, love, and professionalism for animals. Highly recommended.
The best groomer in Naples. Kind, helpful, and passionate about his work and our four-legged friends! A guarantee!

You can tell when work is done with love!
We were very happy and will definitely see you soon ❤️

It was my first time taking my dog ​​to the groomer, and I have to say I'm completely satisfied! He greeted us with such kindness and took care of every detail. When we finished, Nega was clean, smelled great, and you could definitely see the difference. I'll definitely be back, especially for the professionalism, love, and dedication shown.

I brought my 10-year-old dog Kira. I knew she was very fearful and had little experience with grooming. I imagined it would be difficult to wash her, but Domenico did a great job with professionalism and care! Highly recommended.

Kindness and professionalism were the watchwords of this short visit to "La Boutique del Pelo." A quick stop in Naples, and the owner was very accommodating in setting up an appointment with us. He immediately put both our 5-month-old puppy and us at ease. Oliver thanks you!

Many people had recommended him to me, and I finally found him! A true professional, especially when it comes to dealing with my puppy, who is super fearful. He knew how to handle her perfectly, and now she is so soft and smells wonderful! Already a loyal customer.

I'm really satisfied with the service! My Roxy arrived smelling terrible and with a messy coat, but after washing she came home smelling good, clean, and beautiful! Thank you also for the helpful advice and your great professionalism: you can tell there's passion and expertise in the work. We'll definitely be back!
In 5 years we have been to many groomers, but no one has ever welcomed our Fati with kindness, manner and professionalism...Thanks Domenico

We went today in the middle of August for the first time, after a lot of research online, we brought our 2-year-old poodle, not very used to grooming but calm. A serious, professional person and above all a lover of his "job". My little moon had a great time and was treated with all the necessary attention. A professional who explained many things to us and gave us lots of useful advice! Excellent value for money. A professional, polite, honest person!!!! We will never change him again!!!!

An absolutely fantastic experience. Even though Edison is a bit exuberant, he was treated with genuine affection and has never been groomed with such care and dedication. Highly recommended. Thank you.

A truly positive experience! I brought my dog ​​for a complete grooming and was greeted with great kindness and professionalism. The groomer was very helpful, carefully listened to our requests, and cared for her as if she were his own. You can tell he does this job with love as well as professionalism.
The result was impeccable: clean, smelling great, and happy! We'll definitely be back. Thank you so much!

A very positive experience. I was looking for a groomer for my Kiara in Rione Alto, where I live, and at the suggestion of Andrea, where I get my food, I discovered Boutique del Pelo. What can I say? Mimmo transformed Kiara from a little frog to a princess, and also gave me lots of advice on grooming. Highly recommended.
Domenico is number 1, there's nothing else to add
Finally Gegé has found the perfect Grooming with Domenico, a sweet, patient and loving boy

PROFESSIONALISM AND LOVE. Thanks to the many changes in my life, Leyla, my beloved Pomeranian, has been taken to several grooming salons, all carefully selected and with excellent reviews. To date, I must say that none of them have been up to the standard of this grooming! Leyla's fur has never been so white, soft, and well-groomed as after this experience. And the most amazing thing is that the results have lasted over time, remaining flawless for days. Another positive note is that all the work is done by a single person, Domenico, who dedicates his attention to just one dog at a time, ensuring complete transparency. We will definitely be back, thank you!!
